Troubleshooting Vacuums 03/31/2026 Print Email Copy Link Share Causes and Symptoms There is a foreign object in the vacuum nozzle.
The vacuum nozzle or extension pipe is not attached properly.
The exhaust filter is not attached properly.
The vacuum cleaner operates by drawing in outside air as the motor rotates.
However, if the nozzle, pipe, or filter is not attached properly, gaps may form and cause an air-leaking sound.
Also, if there is dust or foreign objects in the nozzle or filter, it becomes difficult to draw in air, causing the motor to overwork and become louder.
If the nozzle or pipe is blocked by foreign objects, the suction power becomes excessively strong as it draws air through a narrowed passage, resulting in noise.
Is the nozzle or pipe blocked by foreign objects such as tissue, stockings, or plastic bags?

What Is Hardware Calibration?
First, check the product specifications or the digital user manual on the LG website to confirm if your monitor supports hardware calibration.
Then, download the latest version of the software from the LG Support website.
Hardware calibration uses a color sensor to directly adjust your monitor's internal settings, rather than just changing your computer's display settings.
This ensures highly accurate and consistent colors.
Note that this feature is available only on specific LG monitors that support hardware calibration.

Troubleshooting Air Care Solutions 07/07/2026 Print Email Copy Link Share When you turn on the air conditioner, it creates airflow in the room, which may cause your air purifier to detect dust or gases.
This is normal and does not indicate a malfunction.
Please note The air conditioner does not release dust or gases.
Airflow can move dust around, causing your air purifier to detect it.
If the indicator continues to show 'Poor' after extended use, we recommend checking your filter.
Why does your air purifier indicator change when the air conditioner is on?
Your air conditioner repeatedly takes in indoor air, cools it, and releases it back into the room.
This creates airflow that can move dust or gases around, causing your air purifier to detect them.
Even if the air quality indicator turns red ('Poor'), both units are operating normally.
If the air purifier filter is dirty, clean or replace it.
